name: Anastasia Austin
original_name: アナスタシア＝オースティン
source:
The Holy Princess who reigns at the top of the Holy Kingdom, Austin.

Having just lost her mother, the previous queen, she now rules the country at a young age.

As she is not yet old enough to succeed her as queen, her title remains Princess.

A brave woman who willingly takes part in battles to inspire her soldiers, her skills are said to be the best in the Holy Kingdom, and she is hailed as the reincarnation of the Valkyrie who once led the Fileille Holy Warriors and sealed away the great magician with her own hands.
